design: INDIVIDUAL 14: a very slender ancient council record-keeper with long limbs and pale spotted rust skin, broad ridged head and narrow inner tooth-filled mouth surrounded by four separate external mandibles. Long sparse grey tendrils braided together only at the tips using leather bands. A long sage robe with plum cuffs, asymmetrical knee-length ceremonial shawl and five tiny bronze sealed cylinders hanging at the belt. Supports a broad unfolded council parchment-like panel with one hand while pointing at it with the other.
